bibliographic.title: Virtual Adventure of Bored Edwin (by Storyteller)
bibliographic.author: One Boat Crew
bibliographic.description:
The last of eight student-created games in the KINGS & QUEENS anthology for ECTOCOMP 2026.

An interactive fiction game created by a 16-year-old student from SIF Creative Studio (Senica, Slovakia) as part of the Four-Hour Authoring Marathon on non-linear fiction for ECTOCOMP 2026. The game is submitted in the Petite Mort category, following this year's creative challenge: the theme KINGS & QUEENS and the genre ESCAPE FROM VIRTUAL REALITY.
